Cross term is lower-order by Cauchy-Schwarz; a.s. fixed-A limit B/A. Independently quadrature verified universal real integral 2.07655885436006, equal to 2 sqrt(pi)(2-sqrt2). Separate fixed from resampled noise; lambda0, tau boundaries checked.
